result.reason: The operative language appropriately limits renewals to 12 months and reduces the non-renewal notice period to 30 days. However, it does not include the preferred 60-day Vendor renewal reminder or any cap on renewal price increases. Because the fallback also requires price increases to be capped at 5%, the clause reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. The edits made are narrow, preserve the mutual non-renewal right, and are professionally drafted, but the margin comment cannot cure the missing operative protections.
